about: What Dependabot cannot see (.github/dependabot.yml covers the actions and tools/package.json; Node's pin is the core's, core/.node-version), each read from its file by its pattern (never written here), for the core's monthly versions check (its format and workings: core/scripts/versions.mjs). How this game takes them: docs/developing.md.

entries.name: peerjs
entries.how: PeerJS loads from cdnjs in every player's browser, so it is what ships to players: take it as docs/developing.md says under "PeerJS, what ships to players". Update the address and PEERJS_SRI in net.js, the address in index.html's content security policy, its entry and its bundled packages' in tools/licences.json, and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt; then run the online and csp suites.
